title: @pyreon/lint configuration
description: Schema for .pyreonlintrc.json — configures the @pyreon/lint linter. Reference this in your config via `"$schema": "./node_modules/@pyreon/lint/schema/pyreonlintrc.schema.json"` for IDE autocomplete + validation.

preset.description: Base preset to extend. Recommended is the safe default. `lib`=strict+architecture; `app`=disable lib-only rules; `best-practices`=recommended + all opt-in best-practice rules (library rules self-gate on package.json deps).

groups.description: Severity for a whole rule GROUP, in one line. Applied after the preset and BEFORE per-rule entries, so an explicit rule always wins over its group. `pyreon` = framework semantics; `a11y` = accessibility; `pkg` = per-library, dependency-gated; `internal` = rules that encode the Pyreon repository itself (never on in a shipped preset).

pyreon.description: Framework semantics — reactivity, JSX, lifecycle, SSR/SSG.

a11y.description: Accessibility — standard markup plus Pyreon primitives, toast, dialog, overlay.

pkg.description: Per-library rules; each self-activates on a declared dependency.

internal.description: Rules encoding the Pyreon repository itself. Off in every shipped preset.

security.description: Exploitable shapes — script URLs, opener leakage, unsanitized HTML sinks.

isomorphic.description: The hydration contract, for files that render on BOTH the server and the client.

backend.description: Server-role files — request handlers, api routes, anything importing `node:`.

web-perf.description: Client-role files — main-thread work that shows up as jank or layout shift, plus teardown that only goes wrong in a real browser.

portable.description: Shared source that must survive iOS and Android as well as the web.

js.description: Language and module-system shapes oxlint cannot express.

rules.description: Per-rule configuration. Each entry is either a bare severity (`"error"` / `"warn"` / `"info"` / `"off"`) or an `[severity, options]` tuple. Rules that support path-based exemption read `options.exemptPaths: string[]`.

include.description: Glob patterns of files to lint (relative to the config file).

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files to skip (relative to the config file). `.pyreonlintignore` and `.gitignore` are honored automatically.

severity.description: Diagnostic severity. `off` disables the rule entirely.

ruleOptions.description: Per-rule options. Most rules support `exemptPaths: string[]` for path-based exemption (each entry is a substring matched against the file path).

exemptPaths.description: File-path substrings to exempt from this rule. Useful for foundation packages that legitimately implement what the rule recommends (e.g. a DOM renderer cannot use `useEventListener`).
